headline: Mara Velez gains 9 positions in Western States race segment
body: Mara Velez, bib 214, moved from position 20 at Michigan Bluff to position 11 at Foresthill, a position gain of 9. This update is based on synthetic timing data from the race segment between Michigan Bluff and Foresthill. All timing events in this portfolio are simulated and labeled as such. The official course spans 100.2 miles with over 18,000 feet of climbing and nearly 23,000 feet of descending. Race management communications define operational cutoffs, and participants must finish by the official Sunday-morning deadline to be eligible for awards.
